hook: What if a massive coral structure hid underwater for 30 years?

sections.voiceover: What if a massive coral structure hid underwater for 30 years?
Researchers recently mapped a massive Pachyseris rose coral colony in the Indian Ocean. How large is this hidden giant?
Local divers first spotted parts of this Indian Ocean colony three decades ago.
Scientists finally confirmed the colony measures 1.56 kilometers in total length. This sprawling structure averages 36.5 metres in width. It remains a colossal natural feature of the Indian Ocean.
Researchers mapped this Pachyseris colony on the outer reef of the Cocos (Keeling) Islands.
